I cancelled the ride and the driver still shows up

That sounds frustrating. Check the ride status in the app to confirm the cancellation went through. If the driver is still assigned or arriving, contact support immediately; don't assume the cancellation is complete.

If the app shows ₹210, that's the fare it's quoting for that trip. I can't verify it from my side, so contact support if it looks wrong.
